description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'BasicWorkScheduleTest' which verifies the behavior of the 'BasicWorkSchedule' class in the OrangeHRM system's Leave module. It includes unit tests for methods that retrieve work shift timings and length, mocking dependencies such as employee data access, service layers, and default work shift times.

classes.name: BasicWorkScheduleTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the 'BasicWorkSchedule' class, testing retrieval of work shift start/end times and shift length with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Tests retrieval of work shift start and end times when employee work shift exists.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTimeEmployeeWorkShiftEmpty
methods.description: Tests retrieval of default work shift times when employee work shift data is absent.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Tests calculation of work shift length from 'WorkShift' entity.
